title: Fees and advances
subtitle: From validated designations to bank transfers: fee scales, checks, payments and advances, with every step on record.

checks.title: Checks
checks.hint: All three checks are required before validation. Each one is set separately.

kpi.outstandingHint: {n} lines to validate, validated or contested
kpi.toPayHint: Validated lines waiting for the transfer

ready.title: To bill
ready.hint: Matches whose crew is validated but whose fees have not been worked out yet.
ready.empty: Everything in the period is billed.

report.title: Last calculation
report.currencyMismatch: Fee scale only in another currency for: {roles}. ARIS applies no exchange rate.
report.defaultScaleUsed: Priced from the platform default scale: {roles}
report.heldByPrevious: Line still in the name of the replaced official: {roles}. Cancel or correct it, then work it out again.

panel.closed: This line is closed and can no longer be changed.

adjust.title: Adjust the amounts
adjust.hint: Every change to an amount needs a reason and is written to the audit log.
adjust.reasonHint: For example: flight dearer than the scale, kick-off 45 minutes late.
adjust.negative: The deduction is larger than the amount due.
adjust.sendsBack: A validated line goes back to “to validate” for another check.

pay.title: Record the payment
pay.hint: The money moves outside ARIS; give the transfer reference so it can be reconciled.
pay.bulkHint: Total: {total}. The same reference is written on every line.
pay.referenceHint: At least 3 characters, for example TRF-2026-0142.

resolve.title: Settle the dispute
resolve.hint: The official disputes this amount. Adjust it first if needed, then settle.

cancel.title: Cancel this line?
cancel.hint: A cancelled line is no longer owed. A paid line cannot be cancelled.

emptyHint: Lines appear once the fees of a validated match have been worked out.

errors.closed: This line is paid or cancelled and can no longer be changed.
errors.bad_state: That is no longer possible in its current state. Reload to see where it stands.
errors.checks_missing: All three checks must be ticked before validation.
errors.not_validated: This needs to be validated first.
errors.negative_total: The deduction is larger than the amount due.
errors.currency_mismatch: This federation's fee scales are in its country's currency.
errors.competition_mismatch: That competition belongs to another federation.

confirm.paid: Confirm that {amount} was paid out to {name}?
confirm.hint: The official is told in their space. The decision is written to the audit log.

kpi.outstandingHint: Approved or paid out, no receipts yet

form.title: Advance for an official
form.hint: For travel that has to be paid before the match. The amount is in the currency of the official's country.
form.justificationHint: What the advance covers: ticket, lodging, visa…

advances.emptyHint: Requests from officials and those entered by the federation appear here.

scales.defaultsHint: Used when a federation has no scale of its own, and only when they are in its country's currency.
scales.readonlyHint: The platform's default scales: read only, used where you have none of your own.
scales.grid: Fee scales by division and role
scales.specificHint: These take precedence over the division's scale.
scales.emptyHint: Without a fee scale, ARIS cannot work out a match's fees.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.hint: What working out the fees would find for each competition and each role.
coverage.ok: Every role of every competition has a scale in the right currency.
coverage.currency: {competition}: scale only in another currency for {roles}

form.hint: One scale per division (or competition) and role. Saving replaces the previous one for future calculations; lines already worked out do not change.
form.currencyHint: 3-letter ISO code. A federation is always paid in its country's currency.

mine.title: My advances
mine.hint: For travel that has to be paid before a match. The federation decides and you are told here.
mine.alreadyDecided: The federation has already decided; this request can no longer be withdrawn.

truncated: Only the {n} most recent lines are shown: narrow the period.
